title: Rescue Squadrons land in Charleston South Carolina
description: An HC-130J and HH-60G Pave Hawk from Moody Air Force Base lands at Joint Base Charleston carrying personnel and equipment from the 334th Air Expeditionary Group pre-positioning to provide relief in the wake of tropical storm Florence. The 334th AEG is a unit comprised of 23d Wing and 920th Wing personnel and assets that have integrated to make one expeditionary search and rescue unit. The AEG is ready to perform surface, fixed wing and rotary SAR operations when needed. (U.S. Air Force video  by Technical Sgt. Chris Hibben)
